claim_boundary: Peer-reviewed research documents both intraday Bitcoin momentum and reversal, with predictability varying by volatility, volume, jumps, liquidity and regime. It does not establish that a large share of absolute H1 price movement in the final six hours improves DRA V1 entry economics. Exactly one frozen equal-capital historical audit may test the final-six-hour absolute log-return share divided by its prior-20-complete-day median at primary 1.00 with 0.80 and 1.20 neighbors. Any economic, predictive, breadth, drawdown, holding, inventory or neighbor failure closes the exact family without changing hours, return definition, lookback, direction, thresholds, parent or accounting.

feature_contract.formula: For one complete 24-bar UTC day, sum abs(ln(close/open)) for H1 bars starting 18:00 through 23:00 UTC and divide by the same sum across all 24 bars. Divide that share by the median of the preceding 20 complete-day shares, excluding the current day.

independence_contract.not_us_session_activity_rescue: The closed 15:00-20:59 UTC session family measured quote-volume share. This feature measures absolute price activity in a fixed final-six-hour window and cannot reopen or retune the volume family.
independence_contract.not_path_efficiency_or_sign_persistence_: Path efficiency measures net displacement versus total path length and sign persistence measures adjacent return signs. This feature measures when absolute movement occurs, regardless of direction.

prior_matrix.finding: The study documents Bitcoin intraday time-series momentum and reports stronger predictability in high-volume or high-volatility trading sessions, while attributing the effect to liquidity provision rather than late-informed trading.
prior_matrix.identity: Shen, Urquhart and Wang, Bitcoin intraday time series momentum, Financial Review 57 (2022) 319-344
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: First-to-last half-hour momentum and session activity do not establish a final-six-hour absolute-movement share, its positive direction or DRA entry value.

prior_matrix.finding: The study reports both intraday momentum and reversal in cryptocurrencies and finds that patterns vary with jumps, FOMC events, liquidity and the COVID period.
prior_matrix.identity: Wen, Bouri, Xu and Zhao, Intraday return predictability in the cryptocurrency markets: Momentum, reversal, or both, North American Journal of Economics and Finance 62, 101733 (2022)
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: Mixed momentum and reversal make direction and annual breadth uncertain and prohibit interpreting concentrated late activity as automatically favorable.

prior_matrix.finding: The existing immutable pre-2025 OKX BTCUSDT H1 selection corpus contains 52,608 complete H1 bars with exact OHLC and quote volume and has already supported deterministic DRA matched-capital research.
prior_matrix.identity: Agora sealed OKX BTCUSDT H1 selection corpus
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: Data completeness and deterministic executability do not establish predictive independence or economic value.

real_time_design_requirements: Use exactly one complete 24-bar UTC day; final-six-hour bars are those starting 18:00 through 23:00 UTC, and execute no earlier than the unchanged next-bar open.
Use abs(ln(close/open)) within each H1 bar; do not substitute high-low range, close-to-close return, direction, volume, volatility or a different time window.
Exclude the current day from the exact prior-20-complete-day median and make zero-total-movement days unavailable rather than assigning zero.
Freeze primary ratio 1.00 and neighbors 0.80 and 1.20 before DRA outcome access.
Keep DRA parent side, entries, exits, lot cost, capacity, fee, adverse slippage, cooldown and next-bar fill clock unchanged.

Require gate set V2 Design and Validation total and realized PnL improvement, annual breadth, drawdown and underwater non-inferiority, holding support, terminal inventory, intervention support, concentration and both-neighbor stability; otherwise close the family.
Do not open post-2024 OOS or create a Trading runtime rule from this audit.
prohibited_substitutions: Do not change six hours to four, eight or a selected session after outcome access.
Do not reverse the relation, use a directional return, add volume, range, volatility, trend or external factors, or search another lookback.
Do not reopen the closed US-session volume, sign-persistence, price-path-efficiency, realized-skewness, first-extreme-order or close-location families.
uncertainty: Late absolute price activity may represent overreaction and reversal risk rather than fresh information, so the preregistered positive direction may fail.
The fixed 18:00-23:59 UTC window is a clock convention in a 24-hour market and may not correspond to a stable economic session.
The feature can remain correlated with realized volatility or daily range even though its exact timing fingerprint is distinct.
